relationships.subject: palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: PEA also modulates the endocannabinoid system by inhibiting FAAH, the enzyme responsible for degrading anandamide (AEA)

relationships.subject: palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: Its pharmacological effects are primarily mediated through peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-alpha (PPAR-α) activation

relationships.subject: palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, PEA activates TRPV1, a receptor involved in pain perception and neuroinflammation.

relationships.subject: palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: By activating CB2 receptors, PEA reduces gut-derived pro-inflammatory cytokines

key_findings: Review: PEA acts via PPAR-alpha, indirect CB1/CB2 modulation, TRPV1 and GPR55; ultramicronized form improves bioavailability.
